name: noir
about: For a dark terminal, measured against #141414. Black-and-white film with one warm light in it: nothing on screen is saturated, and the accent is the only thing that is a colour at all. The discipline that makes it work is that the six source roles separate on lightness and a half-degree of tint rather than on hue — a rose-grey keyword, an olive string, a steel type — which is why they still clear dE*ab 22 from each other with none of them above about a fifth of full chroma.
